newsitem.title: OMAN: National Bank of Oman gets $24.5 mln BCCI payment.
newsitem.headline: National Bank of Oman gets $24.5 mln BCCI payment.

text.p: The National Bank of Oman has received a payment of 9.4 million rials ($24.5 million), equal to 24.5 percent of its claims, from the liquidators of the failed Bank of Credit and Commerce International (BCCI), a bank statement said.

It said it received the payment of "the first interim dividend towards the claims of NBO against BCCI" on December 10, the day worldwide creditors received a total $2.65 billion, equal to 24.5 percent of their claims.
BCCI, founded in 1972, was closed by central banks in 1991 and collapsed with debts of more than $12 billion when evidence of massive fraud and money laundering was unearthed.
BCCI had assets of $24 billion and operations in 71 countries at the time of its collapse.
